svg.aria-label: How to write ಋ: 3 strokes · 2 pen lifts · 7 movements
svg.title: Writing ಋ
svg.desc: 7 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ಋ (kannada), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansKannada-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ru.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಋ, 59 frames, 5.9 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016) <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kannada-alphabet-ru.gif>. Source note on variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಋ in three pen-down runs: the upper-left spiral descends into the lower-left spiral and continues through the rounded middle bowl; after a lift, an inward bar curls upward into the high hook; after a second lift, the right bowl sweeps from the lower join around to its open upper terminal. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten spiral size, bowl width, and hook height vary, but the two-lift order remains the same.
svg.text: How it is written — 3 strokes · 2 pen lifts · 7 movements
Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ru.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಋ, 59 frames, 5.9 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
